manufacturing.title: Thermoforming, tooling and finishing under one roof.
manufacturing.body: Sheet extrusion, forming, trimming and stacking run as a single line, which is what makes a custom format economic rather than exceptional. Tooling is built and maintained in-house, so a new mould is a scheduling question, not a supply-chain one.

materials.title: Food-grade materials
materials.body: PP, PS, PET and PVC selected against your fill temperature, barrier requirement and shelf life.

moulds.title: Custom moulds
moulds.body: Your volume, your diameter, your stacking height. Existing formats are a starting point, not a limit.

tooling.title: In-house tooling
tooling.body: Moulds are cut and maintained on site, which keeps lead time and revision cost under our control.

volume.title: Volume runs
volume.body: Production is planned around recurring monthly commitments rather than one-off batches.

hygiene.title: Hygiene standards
hygiene.body: Forming, stacking and packing follow documented food-contact handling procedures throughout.

leadTimes.title: Lead times

about.title: A packaging line, not a catalogue.
about.intro: Azhar Products makes thermoformed food packaging for dairy, dessert and food-service producers. The short version: we build the tool, run the sheet, and ship the format you actually need.

origin.title: Built around one question from buyers.
origin.body: Every enquiry starts the same way — can you make this format, at this volume, for this fill? The company was organised around answering yes more often than a catalogue supplier can, which is why tooling sits alongside production rather than at a vendor.

facility.title: Extrusion, forming and finishing in sequence.
facility.body: Sheet extrusion, thermoforming, trimming, stacking and packing run as one line. Material moves in a single pass, which keeps handling low and makes short runs of a custom format economic rather than exceptional.

quality.title: Food contact is a process, not a certificate on a wall.
quality.body: Material selection, forming temperature, handling and packing all follow documented food-contact procedures, with traceability from resin lot to finished carton. Certification details are supplied on request with the quote.

equipment.title: Tooling built and maintained on site.
equipment.body: Moulds are cut, trialled and maintained in-house. That is the difference between a new format being a scheduling question and a supply-chain one, and it is what keeps revision cost and lead time under our own control.
